_source: Kiwa Fire Safety Compliance Field of Application Report PAR/21319/01 Revision E (issued 23 Feb 2026, expires 13 Jan 2031). Approved sizes, frames, locks and supporting constructions all come from that report. INTERNAL: internalName is never rendered customer-side.

clearOpening.note: Clear opening is the structural opening less 201 mm on width and 75 mm on height.

structuralAllowance.note: Prepare the structural opening 16 mm larger than the ordered door. The frame provides in-frame adjustment, so no packers or mastic are needed.

_minLeafWidth: The report permits unlimited size reduction, but the smallest leaf in a multi-leaf set shall not be less than 250 mm for vertical stability.

envelopes._note: Approved LEAF envelopes per leaf count, from report section 4.2. Each envelope is a corner pair [[w1,h1],[w2,h2]]: max height h1 up to width w1, sloping to h2 at max width w2. A leaf count is approved when the implied leaf fits ANY of its envelopes. Counts with two entries carry two evidence bases (4.2.2 solid+dashed; 4.2.4/4.2.5 configuration options 1 and 2).

walls.summary: Steel stud plasterboard partition. Approved for all configurations.

walls.summary: Steel stud shaftwall, installed in the plane of the corridor lining. Approved for all configurations.

frames.label: Raised picture frame
frames.summary: Visible architrave with an 8 mm raised return.

locks.summary: Spring-loaded invisible keyhole with a euro cylinder.

locks.label: SLIK+ with thumb turn
locks.summary: Spring-loaded invisible keyhole; metal thumb turn to the rear of the door.

locks.label: SLIK and euro cylinder
locks.summary: Invisible keyhole alongside a visible euro cylinder.

locks.label: SLIK and euro thumb turn
locks.summary: Invisible keyhole with a euro thumb-turn cylinder.

locks.label: Fully concealed SLIK point
locks.summary: Square-drive key operates the deadlocks; the smallest cut-out, protected by the SLIK.

passiveLeafLockNote: Multi-leaf sets: the active leaf carries the 3-point lock; passive leaves carry a 2-point lock as standard.
construction: Steel riser doorset with 1.2 mm Zintec steel leaf skins and stiffeners over a 75 mm Rockwool RS45 mineral wool core, 93 mm leaf thickness. Pivot-hung on welded steel pivot and spring pin systems — no visible hinges. Multi-point locking with spring-loaded invisible keyhole. Intumescent fire seals fitted as standard to stiles, head and threshold.

standards.description: Fire resistance of non-loadbearing elements of construction — up to 120 minutes, both directions of exposure
Fire resistance tests for door and shutter assemblies — supporting test evidence
Laboratory measurement of airborne sound insulation
